verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete. The preset constructors consistently distinguish documentation-derived conventions from caller-supplied configurations, and confirmed_live() promotes only the concrete configuration on which it is invoked. The opt-in probe performs a real SELECT through HttpSparqlEngine, requires parsed solution results, and promotes the same configuration only after that exchange. The focused request-construction and provenance tests exercise the relevant behavior without vacuous mocks. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue was found.
